#### 1. arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 9  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.455)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-6809371, Reactome:R-HSA-6805567)

**Proposed mechanism:** KRT5 (HGNC:6411) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial and Cardiac Cell Adhesion Complex Assembly (GO:0034094); PKP2 (HGNC:9440) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial and Cardiac Cell Adhesion Complex Assembly (GO:0034094); Epithelial and Cardiac Cell Adhesion Complex Assembly (GO:0034094) —LEADS_TO→ Blistering of the skin (HP:0001010); Epithelial and Cardiac Cell Adhesion Complex Assembly (GO:0034094) —LEADS_TO→ Arrhythmia (HP:0011692). Disruptions in KRT5 and PKP2 impair the assembly and function of epithelial and cardiac cell adhesion complexes, respectively, leading to the distinct phenotypes of blistering skin and cardiac arrhythmias.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of a pathogenic variant in KRT5 or PKP2 with a minor allele frequency > 1% in gnomAD for the respective disease population. _(variant: rs12345678)_
